parameters.query:
UPDATE structure_alert_runs
SET status = 'failed',
    error = 'stale running row (likely crash)',
    finished_at = NOW()
WHERE status = 'running'
  AND run_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
RETURNING id, n8n_execution_id, error;

INSERT INTO structure_alert_runs (status, n8n_execution_id, alert_count, tickers, run_at)
VALUES (
  'running',
  '{{ $json.executionId }}',
  0,
  ARRAY[{{ $json.tickers.map(t => "'" + t.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') }}]::text[],
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *;

return (item.alerts || []).map(a => ({ json: { ...item, message: a.message, alert: a } }));

parameters.query:
UPDATE structure_alert_runs
SET status = 'ok',
    alert_count = {{ $json.alertCount }},
    slack_ts = {{ $json.slackTs ? "'" + $json.slackTs + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    error = NULL,
    notify_error = NULL,
    finished_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.runId }}'::uuid
RETURNING *;

UPDATE structure_alert_runs
SET status = 'failed',
    error = {{ JSON.stringify(($json.step || 'pipeline') + ': ' + ($json.error || 'unknown')) }},
    notify_error = {{ $json.notify_error ? JSON.stringify($json.notify_error) : 'NULL' }},
    finished_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.runId }}'::uuid
RETURNING *;

meta.notes: Credentials: Slack Bot (chat:write + im:write for DM / channels:read or groups:read for channel preflight), Header Auth Massive (name apiKey, value YOUR_KEY — query or header per Massive docs), Postgres structure_alert_n8n. n8n Variables: SLACK_ALERT_CHANNEL, HEALTHCHECK_URL, MASSIVE_BASE_URL, STRUCTURE_ALERT_TICKERS. Do NOT enable N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false. Error Workflow → Structure Alert — Error Handler. Schedule 4:25pm ET.
